title.en: OpenAI completes restructuring as a for-profit benefit corporation, ending years of governance uncertainty
title.zhHans: OpenAI 完成营利性公益公司重组，结束多年治理不确定性

searchSummary.en: OpenAI completed its PBC (Public Benefit Corporation) restructure in 2025 — ending years of governance uncertainty. How the restructuring shaped AI’s most influential company.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2025 年完成公益公司（PBC）重组——结束了多年的治理不确定性。这次重组如何塑造了 AI 领域最有影响力的公司。

summary.en: On October 28, 2025, OpenAI completed its transformation into a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), abandoning the nonprofit-control structure that had governed it since 2015. The restructuring, approved by Delaware and California authorities, created OpenAI Group PBC — a for-profit entity with a public benefit mission. The nonprofit received a $130 billion stake in the new company. The move ended years of governance drama — including Sam Altman's 2023 firing and rehiring, Elon Musk's $97.4B hostile bid in February 2025, and debates about whether AI could be safely developed under nonprofit governance.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 10 月 28 日，OpenAI 完成了向公益公司（PBC）的转型，放弃了自 2015 年以来一直管理该组织的非营利控制结构。这一重组获得了特拉华州和加州当局的批准，创建了 OpenAI Group PBC——一个具有公益使命的营利实体。非营利组织在新公司中获得了 1300 亿美元的股份。此举结束了多年的治理戏剧——包括 Sam Altman 2023 年被解雇和重新聘用、Elon Musk 2025 年 2 月的 974 亿美元敌意收购，以及关于 AI 是否可以在非营利治理下安全发展的辩论。

narrative.en: OpenAI's governance had been a central drama in the AI industry since November 2023, when its nonprofit board fired CEO Sam Altman — only to rehire him days later under pressure from employees and investors. The episode exposed fundamental tensions in OpenAI's structure: the nonprofit board was legally obligated to pursue AI safety over profits, but the company's for-profit arm needed massive investment to compete. Throughout 2024 and 2025, various restructuring proposals were floated and debated. Elon Musk's February 2025 hostile bid for $97.4 billion to buy the nonprofit further complicated matters. By mid-2025, OpenAI had developed a plan: convert to a Public Benefit Corporation, a structure used by Anthropic and xAI that allowed for-profit operation with a public benefit charter. The final restructuring, announced October 28, had three main elements: (1) OpenAI's for-profit arm became OpenAI Group PBC; (2) the nonprofit retained a significant stake (valued at $130 billion) and would pursue charitable AI safety work; (3) Microsoft solidified its position as a major shareholder. The restructuring enabled OpenAI to raise capital on standard terms — no longer constrained by the nonprofit's cap on investor returns. Critics argued that the restructuring was a betrayal of OpenAI's original mission — a nonprofit dedicated to building safe AGI for humanity. Supporters countered that building frontier AI required tens of billions of dollars that only a for-profit structure could raise. The restructuring was the end of an era: the last of the major AI labs to 'grow up' from idealistic origins to corporate reality.
narrative.zhHans: OpenAI 的治理自 2023 年 11 月以来一直是 AI 行业的核心戏剧，当时其非营利董事会解雇了 CEO Sam Altman——只是在员工和投资者的压力下几天后又重新聘用了他。这一事件暴露了 OpenAI 结构中的根本性紧张关系：非营利董事会法律上有义务追求 AI 安全而非利润，但公司的营利部门需要大量投资才能竞争。整个 2024 和 2025 年，各种重组方案被提出和讨论。Elon Musk 在 2025 年 2 月以 974 亿美元敌意收购非营利组织的企图进一步复杂化了局势。到 2025 年中，OpenAI 制定了一个计划：转换为公益公司（PBC），这是 Anthropic 和 xAI 使用的结构，允许在公益章程下进行营利运营。最终重组于 10 月 28 日宣布，有三个主要元素：（1）OpenAI 的营利部门成为 OpenAI Group PBC；（2）非营利组织保留了大量股份（估值 1300 亿美元），并将从事慈善性 AI 安全工作；（3）Microsoft 巩固了其作为主要股东的地位。这次重组使 OpenAI 能够按照标准条款筹集资本——不再受非营利组织对投资者回报上限的限制。批评者认为，重组是对 OpenAI 原始使命的背叛——一个致力于为人类构建安全 AGI 的非营利组织。支持者反驳说，构建前沿 AI 需要数百亿美元，只有营利结构才能筹集到。这次重组标志着一个时代的结束：最后一个主要 AI 实验室从理想主义起源"长大成人"成为企业现实。

description.en: Enabled OpenAI to raise capital on standard for-profit terms, removing nonprofit constraints on investor returns. Microsoft solidified major shareholder position. Nonprofit received $130B stake. Paved way for continued large-scale AI investment.
description.zhHans: 使 OpenAI 能够按照标准营利条款筹集资本，消除了非营利组织对投资者回报的限制。Microsoft 巩固了主要股东地位。非营利组织获得 1300 亿美元股份。为持续的大规模 AI 投资铺平了道路。

description.en: Critics argued restructure betrayed OpenAI's original safety-first nonprofit mission. Raised concerns that profit incentives would override safety considerations in AGI development.
description.zhHans: 批评者认为重组背叛了 OpenAI 最初安全至上的非营利使命。引发了关于利润激励将在 AGI 开发中凌驾于安全考虑之上的担忧。

text.en: OpenAI completed its restructuring as a Public Benefit Corporation on October 28, 2025, with the nonprofit receiving a $130 billion stake in the new for-profit entity.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2025 年 10 月 28 日完成重组为公益公司（PBC），非营利组织在新营利实体中获得 1300 亿美元股份。

sources.quote: OpenAI completes conversion to for-profit business after lengthy legal saga.
OpenAI completes restructure, solidifying Microsoft as a major shareholder.
